source.name: PR Newswire / SailGP - ROCKWOOL renews multi-year commitment to SailGP to 2032
source.note: SailGP's own press release: ROCKWOOL is the team's Title Partner (since 2019, through 2032). SailGP's team page (sailgp.com/teams/rockwool-denmark/) also lists ROCKWOOL as Title Partner.
source.quote: ROCKWOOL has renewed its multi-year commitment to SailGP, extending its title partnership of the Danish-flagged ROCKWOOL Racing SailGP Team through to the end of 2032.

source.name: SailGP team page - ROCKWOOL Denmark (Official Partners)
source.note: Team page partner listings are rendered in the page's embedded data: group 'ROCKWOOL Denmark SailGP Team | Official Partners' lists American Magic. Since February 2026 American Magic owns and operates the team.

summary: Denmark's F50 races under Danish insulation maker ROCKWOOL's name: the team's Title Partner. American Magic, the team's new owner-operator, tops the partner block; Sail Racing and 100% are listed suppliers.
